title: Juicy Roasted Japanese Penne Pasta Tendon
description: A roasted, tender, and indulgent Japanese dish featuring penne pasta, served in a banana leaf vessel, inspired by the Chubu region. This anti-inflammatory friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional tendon dishes.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the penne pasta according to the package instructions, reserving 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sake, and grated ginger to make the tendon sauce.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the bowl and toss to coat with the tendon sauce, adding some reserved pasta water if needed to achieve a creamy consistency.
Brush the banana leaves with vegetable oil and place a portion of the pasta mixture in the center of each leaf.
Fold the banana leaves over the pasta to form a tight package and secure with toothpicks if necessary.
Place the packages on a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the packages from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
